The diff is two offline backtest harnesses (scripts/backtest_ict_scalp.py, scripts/backtest_fvg_range.py), a new shared definition module (scripts/target_basis.py), a new research driver (scripts/research/mi312_scalp_target_arms.py), a correction to an existing research driver (scripts/research/mi307_offline_mfe.py), and docs/research/**. The harnesses are offline research tooling and are NOT imported by the trader -- verified by grep rather than assumed: every src/ reference to either file is a docstring or comment, zero import statements. THE ONE THING WORTH A REVIEWER'S EYE, and it is why this field is longer than a data commit's: both live units are documented VERBATIM PORTS of these harnesses (src/units/strategies/fvg_range_15m.py:228 'a VERBATIM port of scripts/backtest_fvg_range.py::run_backtest's', src/units/strategies/ict_scalp.py:736 'Matches the harness semantics EXACTLY'), so a change to harness entry or exit semantics would silently break that correspondence in a way no test here would catch. Both new flags are therefore strictly ADDITIVE and DEFAULT-OFF, and the default arm is VERIFIED byte-identical rather than argued: the unpatched harness from HEAD and the patched one were run on the same BTCUSDT 5m slice (2025-01-01..2025-04-01) and produced an identical summary, 45 of 45 identical rows, zero changed top-level fields and zero changed meta values -- only two new provenance keys added. The correction to mi307_offline_mfe.py is included here deliberately rather than split: adding the flag to those harnesses is precisely what would have made that script pass a cap to a non-clamping family and label the result live-comparable, so shipping the flag without the gate would introduce the mislabel this unit exists to prevent.
